titles.display: Providence Island Sign Language

extract: Providence Island Sign Language, also known as Provisle, is a village sign language of the small island community of Providence Island in the Western Caribbean, off the coast of Nicaragua but belonging to Colombia. The island is about 15 square miles (39 km2) and the total population is about 5,000, of which an unusual proportion are deaf.
